# Monadier

> Full auto Hyperliquid trading bot — non-custodial, 24/7 automated perpetuals execution across 200+ markets.

Monadier is automated trading software for Hyperliquid. Users deposit USDC on their own Hyperliquid account, approve a trading agent once, and run a full auto trading bot that scans markets 24/7. Monadier never holds private keys or custodies funds.

## Product summary

- **Product**: Full auto Hyperliquid trading bot (web terminal)
- **Custody**: Non-custodial — USDC stays on the user's Hyperliquid account
- **Minimum deposit**: $20 USDC on Hyperliquid (deposits via Arbitrum One native USDC)
- **Markets**: 200+ Hyperliquid perpetual pairs
- **Automation**: 24/7 server-side bot; user starts/stops via dashboard
- **Fees**: No platform subscription; 10% success fee on profitable closes only; Hyperliquid trading fees apply
